Troubleshooting

Code Not Running

  • Check for syntax errors (red underlines)
  • Ensure all imports are correct
  • Look for error messages below the preview
  • Try resetting to the original template

Preview Not Updating

  • Try switching layout modes
  • Refresh the page
  • Check browser console for errors

Component Not Found

  • Verify component name spelling
  • Check component is exported from @clarity-chat/react
  • Some components may be in sub-packages

TypeScript Errors

  • Hover over red underlines for details
  • Add type annotations to fix
  • Some playground limitations may require // @ts-ignore

The Theme Preview component provides a comprehensive live preview of theme appearance with sample UI elements including buttons, cards, inputs, and status messages. It includes an optional interactive editor for customizing colors with color pickers, hex value inputs, theme validation, and export functionality. The component also supports side-by-side theme comparison.

{/* Best Practices Section */}

Best Practices

  • Always validate themes before saving to ensure color contrast compliance
  • Provide export functionality so users can backup their custom themes
  • Show sample UI elements that represent your actual application components
  • Include status messages in preview to test warning/error/success colors
  • Use onThemeChange callback to auto-save changes or mark as unsaved
  • Implement theme comparison to help users choose between options
  • Test custom themes with different content lengths and edge cases
  • Store custom themes in user preferences or local storage
  • Provide preset themes as starting points for customization
  • Show theme metadata (name, author, version) in preview
{/* Use Cases Section */}

Create a dedicated theme builder page where users can create, customize, and export custom themes with live preview of all changes.

{/* Performance Tips Section */}

Performance Tips

  • Use React.memo to prevent unnecessary re-renders of preview samples
  • Debounce theme change callbacks to avoid excessive API calls
  • Memoize color conversion functions (hexToHsl, hslToHex)
  • Lazy load the theme editor panel only when showEditor is true
  • Cache validated theme results to avoid repeated validation
  • Use CSS variables for theme colors for efficient updates
  • Implement virtual scrolling if displaying many theme presets
  • Optimize color picker rendering with requestAnimationFrame

Best Practices

When to Use

  • ✅ File uploads and downloads
  • ✅ Multi-step forms and wizards
  • ✅ Data processing operations
  • ✅ Installation or setup processes
  • ✅ Long-running tasks with known duration

When Not to Use

  • ❌ Very fast operations (under 1 second) - may flash
  • ❌ When duration is completely unknown - use Spinner instead
  • ❌ For navigation steps - use Stepper component

Design Guidelines

  • Always show progress from 0% to 100%, never backwards
  • Update progress frequently enough (every 100-200ms) for smooth animation
  • Include descriptive text above or below the progress bar
  • Use colors semantically (green for success, red for errors)
  • Show estimated time remaining for long operations
  • Consider circular progress for space-constrained UIs
  • Use indeterminate progress only when truly necessary

Performance Guidelines

  • Throttle progress updates to avoid excessive re-renders
  • Use CSS transitions for smooth visual updates
  • Avoid updating progress more than 20 times per second
  • Consider debouncing rapid progress updates

certified WCAG 2.1 AAA. Follow this quickstart to keep your implementation compliant as you add custom logic and styles.

Keyboard Support

  • Ensure every new interactive element is focusable and reachable via Tab
  • Use KeyboardShortcutsProvider to register app-wide shortcuts
  • Keep focus states visible (never remove outlines without replacement)

Screen Readers

  • Announce custom actions with ScreenReaderAnnouncement
  • Mark error banners with role=
  • Provide descriptive aria-label values for icon-only buttons

Visual Design

  • Maintain ≥ 7:1 text contrast (the default theme already complies)
  • Respect prefers-reduced-motion when adding new animations
  • Keep touch targets ≥ 44 × 44 px (use getTouchTargetClass)

Testing Checklist

  • Run npm run test to execute jest-axe suites
  • Use Playwright axe project (npm run test:e2e) for end-to-end flows
